scope: Eight bounded coarse/fine simulated-annealing chains and complete final neighborhoods of two leaders. Finalists fully policy optimized and canonically replayed. No global lower bound or impossibility proof.
interpretation: Distant annealing did not beat the imported centers. The improvements in the final report came from the complete final-neighbor rings and combinations of measured improving final changes. The bounded fine phases do not prove that longer recovery from distant starts cannot succeed.
